actions.name: configure_tcp_ulp_mptcp
actions.command_template: sysctl -w net.mptcp.mptcp_enabled=1 && sysctl -w net.mptcp.path_manager=mptcp_balia && echo '{flags}' > /proc/sys/net/mptcp/ulp_flags && echo '{rem_token} {loc_token} {sn} {ssn} {off} {maplen}' > /sys/kernel/debug/tcp_ulp_mptcp

actions.name: change_socket_state
actions.command_template: Change the state of socket {s} to {new_state}
